title: electrolyteFit operation

data.label: gamma_pm and phi of one salt at one temperature

description: Regresses the parameters of ONE fully dissociated salt in water against its mean ionic activity coefficient gamma_pm and osmotic coefficient phi at one stated temperature, with the engine's own closed forms (PitzerSingleSalt: beta0, beta1, Cphi, and beta2 for a 2:2 salt; ENRTLSingleSalt: tau_m_ca, tau_ca_m with alpha fixed). The residual is ln gamma_pm and phi, equal weight; the search is Levenberg-Marquardt. Optionally holds out every N-th point (interleaved points of the same source, reported beside the in-sample errors and never called a validation), grades the in-sample maximum relative error, and writes a proposal file a catalogue record is held equal to (DEV.md 4c C311).

cation.title: Cation species
cation.description: Species key of the cation, e.g. Na; its charge comes from its species record.

anion.title: Anion species
anion.description: Species key of the anion, e.g. NO3.

dataset.title: Dataset
dataset.description: A dataset file with columns m (mol/kg), gamma and phi, and a held-constant `temperature`.

heldOut.title: Held-out points
heldOut.description: `{ every N; offset k; }` -- the points whose 0-based position in the file satisfies index % N == k are never handed to the fitter.

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: `{ limits_pct ( c w s ); }` -- upper limits, in per cent, of clean, warning and severe for the in-sample maximum relative error of gamma_pm or phi.

objective.title: Objective
objective.description: Only `method leastSquares;` is built for this op.
